fee_notes: Royalty 6% of Gross Revenue; Property Management Services taxed at 1.5% separately. BMF 0.50% of Gross Revenue (franchisees joining after 3/30/2022). Minimum monthly royalty $500, subject to annual CPI+3% or Treasury+3% or NAR home sales increase+3% adjustment. Flat BMF rate 0.50%; pre-3/30/2022 franchisees may have different rates per existing agreements.
